prerequisites: All credit points including practical phase must have been earned, with the exception of 6 credit points from the 5th and 6th regular study semesters.
The colloquium should generally take place up to 4 weeks after the submission of the Bachelor's thesis (see APO §16 (8)).

learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to present and defend their Bachelor's thesis in a scientific discussion before a professional audience.
They possess the corresponding competence to recall specialized knowledge in related and neighboring areas.

syllabus_topics: Presentation of Bachelor's thesis results in a lecture and subsequent scientific defense.

The presentation includes: a) brief introduction to the topic and essential questions and tasks of the Bachelor's thesis b) solution approaches and technical developments of the Bachelor's thesis c) possible problem solutions and discussion of results.
The colloquium lasts 30 minutes: 15 minutes presentation of the Bachelor's thesis plus 15 minutes of questions on the presentation and adjacent areas.

assessment_methods.method: Presentation (15 minutes) with question round (15 minutes) on the presentation and adjacent subject areas (total 30 minutes)

assessment_rules: To receive credit points, the module examination must be passed. The grade is weighted according to ECTS credit points.
